The Thesis

The toughest creature alive,
reimagined as infrastructure.

A tardigrade is the only animal to survive the raw vacuum of space — plus radiation, boiling heat, absolute zero, and decades without water. It endures because it has no single point of failure. That isn't just biology — it's the blueprint for AI infrastructure that never goes down.

💥

The Problem

Today's AI runs on infrastructure you can unplug — one data center, one cloud region, one company. Cut the power, the workload dies.

🐾

The Tardigrade Way

$TARDI spreads every AI job across independent nodes in different regions. No single machine to kill, no single owner, no off switch.

♾️

The Result

A compute network that runs through crashes, outages, and failures. The meme gets you in — the network keeps you here.

Live Swarm

Watch the network stay alive.

Every node is independent. Connections re-route around any failure in real time. This is the swarm that can't be killed — visualized.

How to Buy

Join the swarm in 4 steps.

Get a Phantom wallet

Install Phantom from phantom.app (official site only). Save your seed phrase on paper — never share it with anyone, ever.

Fund it with SOL

Buy SOL on any exchange and send it to your Phantom wallet address.

Open the official $TARDI page

Use only the contract address pinned in our socials. Beware impersonator tokens.

Swap SOL → $TARDI

Enter an amount, confirm in Phantom, and welcome to the swarm. 🐾

FAQ

Questions, answered.

Is $TARDI safe / can the team rug?

Mint & freeze authorities are revoked and liquidity is burned on graduation — verifiable on RugCheck and Birdeye. That means supply can't be inflated, wallets can't be frozen, and liquidity can't be pulled. Always verify with the official contract address before buying.

What's the actual utility?

$TARDI incentivizes a decentralized network of AI compute nodes. Operators stake $TARDI to join and earn from running AI jobs; clients pay $TARDI for downtime-proof inference that's replicated across independent nodes. The meme is the front door; the network is the moat.

How do I buy it?

Get a Phantom wallet, fund it with SOL, open the official $TARDI page using the pinned contract address, and swap. See the "How to Buy" section above.

Why a tardigrade?

It's the most indestructible animal known — it survives the vacuum of space, radiation, and absolute zero because it has no single point of failure. That's exactly what decentralized infrastructure is: unkillable because it's everywhere at once.

Is this financial advice?

No. $TARDI is a high-risk, speculative meme token with an experimental roadmap. Nothing here is financial, investment, or legal advice. Never invest more than you can afford to lose.
